purpose: Define when an observation sleeve can be promoted to a V57f core candidate.

rules.rule: V57f is frozen during promotion audit.
Local daily simulation must exist and use real dividends where applicable.
rules.threshold_or_condition: summary_path exists and dividend/order outputs are reviewed

rules.rule: Paper tracking or clean forward evidence is required before core candidacy.
rules.threshold_or_condition: paper_tracking_status == paper_artifact_exists and future window is not retroactive

rules.rule: Drawdown cannot materially worsen versus V57f.
Information ratio cannot be materially worse than V57f.
Small-sample/specialist sleeves need separate capped policy.
rules.threshold_or_condition: no small_sample/specialist class unless PM approves capped sleeve

rules.rule: Cycle-state or specialist-data gaps must be closed ex ante.
rules.threshold_or_condition: required industry data gate is passed

hard_blocks: Historical return alone cannot promote a sleeve.
Small-sample sleeves cannot become ordinary core sleeves without a separate PM-approved capped policy.
Order-health needs_review blocks paper tracking and core promotion.
Archived/data-gate-failed sleeves cannot be reopened by high backtest return.
This policy does not modify V57f or generate a 2026-10 paper runner.
